title: Agent as Content Producer
decision_boundary: May this agent-produced artefact be accepted as produced under a valid, in-scope mandate and declared transformation policy at the evaluated decision time?

cases.condition: recognized agent, valid principal mandate, and in-scope action/resource/purpose
cases.rule_source_reference: Repository walkthrough policy; not an upstream CAWG/C2PA/TRQP requirement

cases.condition: recognized agent but action, resource, purpose, recipient, transformation, or tool is outside mandate
cases.rule_source_reference: Repository walkthrough policy; not an upstream CAWG/C2PA/TRQP requirement

cases.condition: principal authority or agent delegation is revoked at the evaluated decision time
cases.rule_source_reference: Repository walkthrough policy; not an upstream CAWG/C2PA/TRQP requirement

cases.condition: required authority, delegation, policy, or revocation evidence is stale or unavailable
cases.rule_source_reference: Repository walkthrough policy; not an upstream CAWG/C2PA/TRQP requirement

cases.condition: authoritative sources or material verifier dependencies return incompatible results
cases.rule_source_reference: Repository walkthrough policy; not an upstream CAWG/C2PA/TRQP requirement

cases.condition: material provenance, mandate, scope, or authority evidence is corrected after the original decision
cases.rule_source_reference: Repository walkthrough policy; not an upstream CAWG/C2PA/TRQP requirement

limitations: The result establishes scoped production authority and provenance state; it does not establish factual truth of the content.
A production mandate does not confer submission, publication, verification, or decision authority.
